title: OpenAI says it's doubling Pro usage limits and bringing Work features to Chat
content_md: OpenAI has just confirmed that it's rolling out ChatGPT Work capabilities directly into regular Chat, while also combining usage allowances across ChatGPT and Codex. In an email seen by BleepingComputer, OpenAI noted that it will test a combined experience for Chat and Work tabs in the coming weeks, initially with a small group of users. If you're selected for the test, you'll be able to move from ordinary conversations to more complex tasks without switching modes. "This will enable you to move from exploring an idea to having ChatGPT carry it through, all in one place," OpenAI explained. "You can bring in your files and plugins and ask ChatGPT to build a website, create a presentation, or do things for you on the web, while reviewing and guiding its work." The combined experience will initially be tested with a small group of users before OpenAI expands it to more people. It is worth noting that Codex will remain a separate experience in the ChatGPT desktop app. There's another significant change coming to Pro subscriptions. OpenAI is preparing to unify usage across ChatGPT and Codex, meaning both services will draw from the same allowance. "Your use of ChatGPT and Codex will draw from the same allowance," OpenAI noted in the email. However, not every conversation will consume that allowance. OpenAI says Unlimited Instant is included in the subscription and won't count towards the shared usage limit. More advanced models and complex tasks will consume more of your allowance
exclude_reason: OpenAI product/usage update; vendor marketing, not a security event
